title: Ministry of Home Affairs statement (PIB, 11 Nov 2026, 19:39 IST): Tourist Visa renamed Visitor Visa (V-1: 30 days, multiple entries, covers tourism plus business meetings, medical consultations, wellness retreats, short treatment, short courses in Indian languages, music, art and craft; V-2: valid 1, 5 or 10 years; mountaineering six months, multiple entry); visa application form fields cut 65-70% across all 23 sub-categories; main visa categories cut from 13 to 9 and sub-categories from 49 to 23 on 27 Aug 2026 (after Oct 2025: 22 to 13, 63 to 49); medical visas M-1 (non-AYUSH) and M-3 (AYUSH) ordinarily one year, multiple entry, attendants M-2/M-4; students S-1/S-2, e-S1 via Study in India up to five years or course length, whichever is less; business B-1 (long-term, licence-based) and B-2 (short-term, contract-based, incl. Production Investment Business Visa on e-Visa, was e-B4); e-Visa already for 172 countries. Not in use yet: no start date in the statement; officials told The Indian Express issuance under the new framework starts by year-end.
